svg.text: Deel → OpenAccountants · contractor-tax demo [MOCK (set OA_MCP_TOKEN + DEEL_API_TOKEN to go live)]
🌍 Anna Schmidt · DE · $90,000 YTD · form: W-8BEN [full-time/exclusive]
OpenAccountants → US contractor payments (1099 / W-8BEN / classification) (tier 1, signed off by Amir Pelinkovic (US lead))
⚠️ Misclassification / permanent-establishment risk
A full-time, exclusive 'contractor' in DE looks like an employee — risking reclassification, back payroll taxes, and a taxable presence (PE) for the company there. Consider an EOR or a local entity.

🌍 Raj Patel · IN · $25,000 YTD · form: none [works in US]
OpenAccountants → US contractor payments (1099 / W-8BEN / classification) (tier 1, signed off by Amir Pelinkovic (US lead))
⚠️ Foreign contractor — no W-8BEN on file
Get a W-8BEN on file (foreign persons get no 1099). Services performed in the US can trigger 30% US-source withholding (or a treaty rate).
